title: BisonBord
description: Our premium quality, interior-grade BisonBord® serves a wide variety of purposes across homes, offices and retail spaces. BisonBord is available as E1 (Class 1) or E2 (Class 2)*.

howItIsMade.description: Wood chips are refined, dried and sorted by size into coarse and fine wood particles. These are then lightly coated with a precise amount of resin and formed into a three-layer mat. The layers are pressed together using heat and pressure to produce panels with specific thickness and density.

title: I-Melawood
description: MelaWood® is PG Bison’s leading brand of melamine-faced board (MFB).

howItIsMade.description: Our top-quality BisonBord® is covered on both sides with decorative paper that has been infused with melamine resin using heat and pressure. When the resin-coated paper is pressed, the resin flows and hardens to create a smooth, non-porous surface. This means there are no microscopic pores for germs to hide; it also makes the surface so much easier to clean with a damp cloths.The cured melamine surface provides a durable finish that is scratch and moisture-resistant. To finish the job, the edges of the cut MelaWood® panels are sealed using a suitable glue and edge-banding material – this gives each panel the best protection possible against exposure to moisture.As a further benefit, a special anti-bacterial additive is blended into our melamine resin, which helps destroy any bacteria that may come into contact with the surface within hours. MelaWood® is the perfect solution for hygiene-sensitive, high-traffic areas where cleanliness alone is insufficient, such as healthcare facilities, office spaces, schools, restaurants, retail and in your home.

title: MelaWood SupaGloss
description: Bring a touch of luxury with the glass-like MelaWood SupaGloss. This UV-hardened gloss surface, locally manufactured according to the latest international standards, offers rich colours and excellent durability.

howItIsMade.description: Hot-coated polyurethane (PUR) is applied to MelaWood® with a SupaWood® core and then cured using ultraviolet (UV) light to produce a durable, high-gloss surface with good wear and scratch resistance.This technology also gives MelaWood® SupaGloss™ its consistent stability and visual depth.MelaWood® SupaGloss™, locally manufactured by PG Bison to international standards, gives you the assurance of a readily available product, consistent in colour and surface finish. You will never have to worry about one batch of boards not matching the next or discolouration.With matching décor in a PEEN finish on the reverse side, MelaWood® SupaGloss™ is supplied with a protective film to protect the gloss face during handling and processing, so your finished product arrives on site looking as good as expected.

description: Wood Chemicals SA (Pty) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of PG Bison, supplies Formaldehyde and Formaldehyde based Resins into more than 30 different industries throughout sub-Saharan Africa.
